data.text:
K-pop idol group ENHYPEN and their agency Belift Lab announced a ₱4-million donation to support communities affected by recent flooding in the Philippines, a gesture the group said was inspired by their deep bond with Filipino fans. 

In a heartfelt message, the members said they hoped the contribution would help those in need and expressed that the Philippines “has long been close to [their] hearts,” especially as it hosted their first-ever stadium concert in Southeast Asia. 

The group consists of seven members: Heeseung, Jay, Jake, Sunghoon, Sunoo, Jungwon, and Ni-Ki.

"We became aware of the recent severe flooding affecting many communities across the Philippines, a country that has long been close to our hearts," the members said in a joint statement. 

"We wanted to offer our support, even in a small way, and sincerely hope the contributions will be used to help those in need and assist in the ongoing recovery efforts," they added.

The donation will be coursed through Hope Bridge Korea Disaster Relief Association in partnership with the Philippine Disaster Resilience Foundation to aid recovery and rebuilding efforts.

data.text:
THANK YOU, ENHYPEN!

Magbibigay 100 million won o mahigit P4 million ang K-Pop boy group na ENHYPEN para sa flood relief efforts sa Pilipinas, ayon sa ulat ng The Korea Times.

“We became aware of the recent severe flooding affecting many communities across the Philippines, a country that has long been close to our hearts,"  saad ng grupo.

Ipapadala ang kanilang donasyon sa pamamagitan ng non-governmental organization (NGO) na Hope Bridge Korea Disaster Relief Association sa pakikipagtulungan sa Philippine Disaster Resilience Foundation.
